54.90903,-1.37264: Bodlewell Lane. Site of the Bodle Well, Old Sunderland 's main water supply through the 17th, 18th and 19th centuries. A bodle, a Scottish coin worth half a farthing, would buy a skeel or 2 gallons of water.

54.90916,-1.37029: 10 & 11 Church Street Built in 1711 as part of a street of merchants' houses that linked the Parish Church with the commercial High Street and Riverside.
